entities.summary: Nikolay Vladimirovich Pavlov is a Russian and prior 2007 Ukrainian volleyball player who plays for the Russia men's national volleyball team and the Russian club Gubernija. Pavlov and his team won the 2013 World League and the 2013 European Championship. He was named MVP at the 2013 World League.
